prompt: # BUILD PROMPT — "HORTUS — a Closed World" · Neumorphic Landing Page **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build the complete, production-ready landing page specified below **in a single attempt**. Do not ask clarifying questions — make expert decisions autonomously and deliver final, runnable code. --- ## 1. THEME & CREATIVE DIRECTION **1.1 — Identity** - Brand: **HORTUS — a closed world** — a premium brand for hand-sealed, self-sustaining terrariums (closed ecosystems that live for years without watering). - Style: **Neumorphism (soft-UI)** with purposeful **gradient accents**. - Keywords: terrarium, ecosystem, neumorphism, gradient. Era: 2020s digital. - Mood: organic, calm, botanical luxury. Everything should feel like soft moss, glass, and pressed paper. **1.2 — Color Palette (use exactly these hues)** - Primary set: `#1c2418` (deep forest), `#10160c` (near-black forest), `#c9d8b8` (sage). - Secondary set: `#6a5a3a`, `#4a3e28`, `#3a3020` (earth/soil browns). - Light mode is the **default aesthetic**; dark mode is a fully token-swapped secondary theme (see 2.4). **1.3 — Copy & Locale** - Write **all user-facing copy in English**. No lorem ipsum anywhere. - Write real, thematic marketing copy (sealed water cycles, zero maintenance, glass biomes). Suggested direction (adapt freely, stay on-theme): hero H1 "A world that waters itself."; CTAs "Build your world" / "How it works"; pricing tiers "Sprout / Canopy / Monolith"; FAQ about condensation, lifespan, placement. --- ## 2. MANDATORY ARCHITECTURE RULES **2.1 — CSS-First, Zero Inline CSS** - All styling lives in `style.css`. **The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden** anywhere in the HTML. - Target every rule via class/ID selectors only. HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic: changing the theme must never require markup edits. **2.2 — Design Tokens (CSS variables, required set)** Define in `:root` (Light, default) and swap in dark themes. Required variables: ```css :root { /* Surfaces & text (Light default) */ --bg-primary: #c9d8b8; /* page surface — mid-tone sage, NOT white */ --bg-secondary: #1c2418; /* dark panels (CTA band, footer) */ --primary: #1c2418; --primary-contrast: #c9d8b8; --secondary: #6a5a3a; --secondary-contrast: #fefefe; --text-primary: #10160c; /* dark text on light bg */ --text-secondary: #4a3e28; --text-on-dark: #c9d8b8; /* light text on dark bg */ --text-on-dark-muted: #a9bb93; --text-success: #35603a; --text-error: #97382a; /* AA-verified on sage */ --border-default: rgba(16,22,12,.2); --border-success / --border-error: derived from success/error hues; /* Neumorphic engine */ --nm-shadow: rgba(110,128,88,.5); --nm-highlight: rgba(254,254,254,.65); /* Structure */ --radius-sm: 10px; --radius-md: 18px; --radius-lg: 28px; --radius-pill: 999px; --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(16,22,12,.08); --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(16,22,12,.14); --spacing-gap: 1.5rem; --transition-fast: 150ms; --transition-normal: 300ms; --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); --z-dropdown: 100; --z-modal: 200; --z-toast: 300; /* Gradients */ --gradient-forest: linear-gradient(150deg,#1c2418,#10160c); --gradient-earth: linear-gradient(150deg,#6a5a3a,#3a3020); --gradient-accent: linear-gradient(120deg,#1c2418,#6a5a3a); } ``` - **Contrast pairing (enforced in every theme):** light backgrounds always carry dark text tokens and vice versa. In dark mode the pairing inverts: `--bg-primary: #10160c`, `--text-primary: #c9d8b8`, `--primary: #c9d8b8` with `--primary-contrast: #10160c`, and success/error shift to light variants (`#8fbf7f`, `#e08a72`). Dark-mode neumorphic tokens: `--nm-shadow: rgba(0,0,0,.6)`, `--nm-highlight: rgba(70,90,55,.28)`. - Light mode must **never** use pure `#ffffff`; where a near-white is required, use `#fefefe` (glass highlights, text on brown). - Verify every text/background pair in **both** themes meets WCAG AA (4.5:1; 3:1 for large display text). Adjust token values if needed — mood survives, contrast wins. **2.3 — Neumorphic Surface System** - Extruded: `box-shadow: 8px 8px 18px var(--nm-shadow), -8px -8px 18px var(--nm-highlight);` (also define a `--nm-out-sm` 4px variant). - Pressed/inset: `box-shadow: inset 5px 5px 12px var(--nm-shadow), inset -5px -5px 12px var(--nm-highlight);` - Neumorphic elements sit on `--bg-primary` (same hue as the page — shadows create the depth, never gradients on interactive surfaces). Gradients are reserved for: hero accent word, dark CTA/footer bands, featured pricing ring, the terrarium illustration, and subtle background washes. - Neumorphism is contrast-hostile: every interactive element must therefore also carry a visible border (`--border-default`) or strong affordance so it is discoverable, plus a high-contrast focus ring. **2.4 — Dark Mode (mandatory — explicit exception clause)** - The source spec marks this theme Light ✓ / Dark ○; Light is the default aesthetic, but the mandatory dark mode is **not waived** — it must be fully implemented, toggleable, and token-swapped. - Implement dark tokens twice for no-flash, no-JS correctness: once under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` scoped to `:root:not(.light)` and once under the `.dark` class on ``. The JS explicitly sets `.dark` or `.light` per stored preference. - Provide a **visible theme toggle** in the header: icon-only `
